name: SurgeDM
author: SurgeDM contributors
description: Monitor and control a local SurgeDM server from the Omarchy bar.

command.description: Surge executable name or absolute path

host.description: Optional host:port or URL; empty auto-detects the local server

downloadDirectory.description: Optional output directory for downloads added from the widget

serviceUnit.description: systemd user unit controlled by the Start and Stop buttons

serviceControlsEnabled.description: Show controls for the systemd user service
